verdict.rationale: The product is itself an autonomous AI research agent. Users hand it a topic, it clarifies direction through a brief exchange, and it then works without further human input for up to about eight hours. It delivers a fully referenced report of up to 100 pages plus slides, and runs can be cancelled mid-execution. Missing for 10: delegation is limited to research and strategy-report tasks rather than general tasks, mid-run interaction is limited to cancelling, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration beyond testimonials on the vendor's own site.
